title: Driver Settlements and Payments | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Driver readiness

Give driver-facing pay questions a traceable support record.

BOF organizes settlement statements, approved work, deductions, advances, adjustments, receipts, questions, evidence, owner, and administrative next action.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Settlement statement, approved work record, rate or pay basis supplied by the fleet, deduction or advance support, receipts, and driver question.

Review path

The record is checked for source match, support for listed items, disputed line, current owner, response state, and required escalation.

Decision-ready output

A documented question or exception with evidence, owner, status, approved correction or escalation, and driver-facing follow-up.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

A disputed line does not disappear between operations, settlement, payroll, and the driver.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Settlement statement, approved work record, rate or pay basis supplied by the fleet, deduction or advance support, receipts, and driver question.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The record is checked for source match, support for listed items, disputed line, current owner, response state, and required escalation.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A documented question or exception with evidence, owner, status, approved correction or escalation, and driver-facing follow-up. A disputed line does not disappear between operations, settlement, payroll, and the driver.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF is not a payroll provider, employer, bank, tax adviser, fiduciary, or payment processor and does not determine legal entitlement.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
